### God Sees You, Beloved
Author: Liz Curtis Higgs
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/god-sees-you-beloved-encouragement-for-today-january-13-2015.html
Passage: Genesis 29:31
Points:
- God sees and deeply cares for those who feel unloved or overlooked by people around them.
- Leah's naming of her first three sons reflects her persistent longing to win her husband's affection.
- With the birth of Judah, Leah shifted her focus from seeking human approval to praising God.
- True contentment comes from thanking God for what we have rather than fretting over what is missing.
- God gave unloved Leah the triumphant honor of placing her directly into the earthly lineage of Jesus.

### Favor Upon Leah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/favor-upon-leah
Passage: Genesis 29:31-35
Points:
- Leah suffered the deep sorrow of being loved less than her sister Rachel.
- The Lord noticed Leah's affliction and acted on her behalf by opening her womb.
- Although Leah initially hoped each son would win Jacob's love, Judah's birth led her to offer praise to God.
- God consistently chooses to lift up and honor those whom the world rejects.
- Leah became the mother of Israel's priestly and royal tribes, foreshadowing Christ's ultimate redemption.
